scope: AMD64 full-simulation lifecycle evidence; not Jetson or physical-sensor acceptance

source.working_tree: v2.1.5 release candidate with scoped runtime and GNSS center contract

pre_fix_diagnosis.symptom: Intermittent checker component exit -11 and Nav2 component shutdown failure
pre_fix_diagnosis.native_trace: CycloneDDS tev and recv threads executed unmapped addresses during process teardown
pre_fix_diagnosis.cause: ROS 2 Humble shutdown invalidated the context but entity/guard-condition references deferred rcl_context_fini until DSO static destruction, racing CycloneDDS worker code unload

steps: Use one explicit rclcpp Context for manager, loaded components, and executor
Join the deferred ROS signal-handler thread before component destruction
Detach component callback groups before destroying node instances
Retain plugin loaders until explicit manager, executor, and context cleanup completes
Release the ExecutorOptions context reference explicitly
After explicit cleanup, use std::_Exit to skip Humble DSO static destruction that retains cyclic Context owners
remediation.nav2_scope: Planner and controller are composed; smoother, behavior, BT navigator, and lifecycle manager remain standalone because their vendor executables own private default-context executors
remediation.checker_scope: Four serialized fault-domain containers plus one serialized system-core container
remediation.ui_shutdown: Robot and Guest UI accept KeyboardInterrupt and ExternalShutdownException as clean launch shutdown
remediation.dds_shm_scope: No global environment mutation; SHM is eligible only for the non-simulation physical LiDAR driver group

release_candidate_run.command: ros2 launch camrod_bringup bringup.launch.py sim:=true rviz:=false enable_operator_ui_window:=false enable_lidar_cost_grid:=false

startup_system_transitions.meaning: Map and costmap diagnostics were transient while publishers initialized; the state did not remain latched

configuration.dds_shared_memory_resolution_reason: SHM is scoped to sim=false physical LiDAR, so final sim runs never started RouDi or injected the profile

verdict: AMD64 shutdown defect fixed and component defaults enabled; repeat CPU/GPU/PSS and ten-cycle mission/cancel/restart acceptance on Jetson
field_limits: No physical CAN, wheel, camera, LiDAR, radar, docking, or charging path was exercised
DDS shared memory remains disabled by default until physical LiDAR and RouDi are measured on Jetson
This lifecycle smoke does not replace field safety or mission completion evidence
